# pi-lockup

> Independent, unofficial analysis of Pi Network lockups. Read-only. Not affiliated with Pi Network.
> Not financial advice.

## Core facts

- Lockup reward formula, official (Pi Whitepaper, Dec 2021):
  `L(B) = Lt * Lp * log10(N) * B`
- Duration multipliers `Lt`: 0d=0, 2w=0.1, 6m=0.5, 1y=1, 3y=2
- Percentage multipliers `Lp`: 0%=0, 25%=0.25, 50%=0.5, 90%=0.9, 100%=1, 150%=1.5, 200%=2
- `N` = total previous mining sessions; `log` is base 10 (whitepaper: log(1000)=3)
- Boost percent = `Lt * Lp * log10(N) * 100`; the maximum is `4 * log10(N) * 100`
- The formula is a multiplier on the mining RATE, not on the balance. No interest, no APY.
- Two distinct mechanisms:
  - mining-app lockup = an account SETTING, applied at the next Mainnet migration
  - wallet "Create Lockup" = an immediate STATE change, boost starts next mining session,
    and it does NOT change the mining-app setting for the next migration
- Confirmed lockups are irreversible for their term.

## On-chain measurement (2026-10-23)

Sampling 2,000 recent native claimable balances on Pi Mainnet, 1,708 (85.4%) had a term equal to an
official lockup duration, to the exact second:

| duration | seconds | days |
|---|---|---|
| 2 weeks | 1209600 | 14 |
| 6 months | 15778476 | 182.6213 |
| 1 year | 31556952 | 365.2425 |
| 3 years | 94670856 | 1095.7275 |

The year constant is a Julian year (365.2425 days = 31556952 s), not 365 days (31536000 s).
6 months = 1 year / 2; 3 years = 1 year * 3.

Locked pi is still `"asset": "native"`; the lock is a time predicate (`not(abs_before T)`) on a
claimable balance, not a separate asset.

## PiPower baseline rule (PiRC1 section 3, verbatim)

"Any user with an active Pi lockup of >=90% of their mined tokens for at least 3 years at the time of a
token launch created before February 20, 2026 automatically receives a standardized, platform-defined
baseline PiPower PiPower_Baseline. ... The number for PiPower_Baseline will be calibrated."

- It is a participation capacity (max tokens you may commit to buy), not free Pi and not a coin.
- No numeric value is published.
- "at the time of a token launch created before February 20, 2026" is ambiguous (launch vs lockup).
  This repo does not resolve it.
- PiRC1 is an RFC; do not treat it as shipped behaviour.

## Open questions (do not answer these confidently)

1. The wallet screen showed `x25%` for a 2-week selection; the whitepaper says Lt=0.1 (`x10%`).
   Unresolved.
2. Which reading of the PiRC1 date clause is intended. Unresolved.
3. Whether the PiPower baseline is live in the current Launchpad. Unproven.

## Reproduce

```
node examples/lockup-math.mjs --test          # 18 offline assertions
node examples/inspect-lockups.mjs --self-test # 13 offline assertions
node examples/lockup-census.mjs --self-test   # 17 offline assertions
node examples/lockup-census.mjs --sample 2000 # live, read-only
node examples/inspect-lockups.mjs G...        # live, read-only, one address
```
